episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her expertise on using YouTube for effective lead generation and conversion in real estate. She outlines a comprehensive system involving Zoom consultations, exploratory trips, and the showing agent model to manage and convert leads efficiently. The episode provides actionable insights for agents looking to optimize their operations and increase their client base through strategic use of YouTube.
